title: When the House Breaks
author: Vesper Montrose
blurb: Silas Ashgrove, a folklorist recording songs the village refuses to sing twice, has spent fifteen years telling themselves the noises have explanations. Then the childhood imaginary friend is waiting on the porch, unchanged — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must learn the song's last verse without singing along, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
